import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix extends ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> {
        public Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                ArrayList<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    row.add(0L);
                }
                this.add(row);
            }
        }

        public static Matrix shift(Matrix a, int shift) {
            int k = a.size() - 1;
            shift = (k - shift) % k;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(a.size(), a.get(0).size());
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    res.get(i).set(j, a.get((i + shift) % k).get((j + shift) % k));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                res.get(k).set(j, a.get(k).get((j + shift) % k));
            }
            return res;
        }

        public static Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            int n = a.size();
            int k = a.get(0).size();
            int m = b.get(0).size();

            long[][] aa = new long[n][k];
            long[][] bb = new long[k][m];

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    aa[i][j] = a.get(i).get(j);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    bb[i][j] = b.get(i).get(j);
                }
            }

            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long tmp = 0;
                    for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                        tmp = (tmp + aa[i][l] * bb[l][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                    res.get(i).set(j, tmp);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        int max_depth = 0;
        long tmpN = n;
        while (tmpN != 0) {
            max_depth++;
            tmpN /= k;
        }

        List<Matrix> dp = new ArrayList<>();
        // Initialize dp matrices
        {
            // matrices for initial level
            Matrix first = new Matrix(k + 1, k + 1);
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    first.get(i).set(j, (i == j || j == 0) ? 1L : 0L);
                }
            }
            dp.add(first);
            Matrix e = new Matrix(k + 1, k + 1);
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                e.get(i).set(i, 1L);
            }
            for (int depth = 1; depth < max_depth; depth++) {
                Matrix prev = dp.get(depth - 1);
                Matrix current = e;
                int curx = k;
                for (int i = 0; (1 << i) <= curx; i++) {
                    if ((curx & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        current = Matrix.multiply(prev, Matrix.shift(current, 1 << i));
                        curx ^= (1 << i);
                    }
                    prev = Matrix.multiply(prev, Matrix.shift(prev, 1 << i));
                }
                dp.add(current);
            }
        }

        Matrix base = new Matrix(1, k + 1);
        base.get(0).set(k, 1L);
        int sl = 0;
        long x = n;
        List<Integer> vec = new ArrayList<>();
        while (x != 0) {
            vec.add((int)(x % k));
            x /= k;
        }
        int len = vec.size();
        for (int cur_depth = len - 1; cur_depth >= 0; cur_depth--) {
            int rest = vec.get(cur_depth);
            for (int it = 0; it < rest; it++, sl = (sl + 1) % k) {
                base = Matrix.multiply(base, Matrix.shift(dp.get(cur_depth), sl));
            }
        }

        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            res = (res + base.get(0).get(i)) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
